__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The guardian is a stone devil, a hideous creation from the dark laboratories
of Hell.  Its black eyes stare into your soul with a hunger that makes you
shiver.  The guardian stands motionless before you.  Its rough grey skin
looks impervious to normal weapons.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A Guardian of Hell stands here, keeping you the Hell out.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle guardian guard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A large sparkly pile of gold coins.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A pile of gold coins lies on the ground.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle pile coins

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This is the most handsome male you have ever seen.  The well-defined
muscles on his naked body make your mouth water.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The male demon Dee lies on the bed, waiting to please you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle male dee demon

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This is the most beautiful female you have ever seen. The curves of her
naked body make you sweat and babble uncontrollably.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The female demon Dee lies on the bed, waiting to please you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle female dee demon

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This gold bar must be worth bucks!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A shiny gold bar lies on the ground.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle bar gold

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see a golden-crusted pot pie filled with chicken and vegetables.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A yummy looking chicken pot pie is here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle chicken pot pie

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see a golden-crusted pot pie filled with beef and vegetables.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A yummy looking beef pot pie is here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle beef pot pie

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see a golden-crusted pot pie filled with vegetables.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A yummy looking vegetable pot pie is here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle vegetable pot pie

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see the faint silhouette of a person. Looking closely at it, you can barely
make out features that would identify it as the person it was in life.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A damned soul wanders aimlessly here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle damned soul

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see a unrecognizable person going through unheard-of and
indescribable torture. It screams out at you in pain and terror.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A tortured soul screams out in pain.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle tortured soul

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This poor soul looks as if he has been chewed on and spit out.  He writhes
He is in agony and terror as he gasps frantically for Death to answer his
desperate plea...
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A half-eaten person lies here, writhing in agony.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle half-eaten person

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The wall consists of greying and sinewy flesh - faces, hands,
broken bones, feet, and toes jutting from the surface. You hear low moans
of horror, pain, and sorrow issuing from within.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A wall stands here. Its surface seems to move and come to life...
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle living wall

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Rotting flesh and gore drop from the bones of this creature.
Its decaying eyes stare at you intently as it sees only your
delicious and juicy brain.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A skeletal warrior wanders the planes of Hell.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle skeletal warrior

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The bloody arm of some poor, luckless individual.  The stench of the
gore-covered limb makes you want to retch.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A bloody severed arm lies here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle bloody severed arm

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This bloody foot definitely wasn't a lucky one.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A bloody severed foot lies here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle bloody severed foot

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
I wonder how the person that lost this smells...Hopefully not as bad as
this nose does...
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A bloody severed nose lies here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle bloody severed nose

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see gallons and gallons of thick red blood gurgling in the fountain.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The blood in the fountain gurgles merrily.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle blood

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This soul is definitely clueless to as where he is. He holds a ticket
that reads #14349023402342039840293481234900049.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A lost soul stands here looking lost.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle lost soul

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This was once a person.  Now it is only a charred and smoking hulk that
is being burned for eternity.  It screams out as the flames lick at its
body and devour its flesh...
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A crispy critter is here, being burned to death.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle crispy critter

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Stringy bits of flesh blow gently in the breeze. The bones rattle as you walk
by them.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A decaying pile of bones lies on the ground.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle pile bones skeleton

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
A gruesome sub-demon who used to be mortal, this is a semi-intelligent
creature who attacks, with nails and teeth, anyone it encounters.  It is
often fed upon by demon lords and princes.  Its green-and-red blotched
skin gives it a diseased and decaying look.  It somewhat resembles a
shadow or a ghost.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A manes wanders the planes of Hell, looking for something to kill.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle manes sub-demon

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This is a sad individual. He smells strongly of the rotten food that has been
thrown at him. He sits here chained to the wall, banished to Hell forever by
the gods.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The prisoner of Hell, Raiden sits here for eternity.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle prisoner raiden

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
She is sad-looking, indeed:  cuts and scrapes all over her.  Many scars
and burns cover her face and arms.  The appalling condition of her once-lovely
breasts makes you avert your eyes.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A sad looking individual sits here, awaiting torture.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle prisoner hell

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He is sad-looking, indeed:  cuts and scrapes all over him.  Many scars
and burns cover his face and arms.  One of his arms is broken at the
elbow and hangs limply by his side.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A sad looking individual sits here ,awaiting torture.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle prisoner hell

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This very large demon stands before you, licking his daggerlike teeth.
Yellow spittle runs down the scales of his blackened skin.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A demonguard patrols the planes of Hell.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle demonguard demon guard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You can barely make out anything on it. All you can make out are the flames
of Hell consuming it, and the smell of burning flesh.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A burning fool is here, crisping away.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle burning fool

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He is the typical construction worker:  T-shirt, jeans, yellow hard hat.
As you look closer at the hard hat, you notice that it says:
             '4th DEMONsion Construction Co.'
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A construction worker is here, welding pipework.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle construction worker male

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
She is the typical construction worker:  T-shirt, jeans, yellow hard hat.
As you look closer at the hard hat, you notice that it says:
             '4th DEMONsion Construction Co.'
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A construction worker, is here working riviting framework.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle construction worker female

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
It is an indescribably grotesque creature.  Its pale, green-yellow skin
erupts with blisters and puss.  As you look at it, it smiles at you with
sharp, blood-covered teeth.  This is definitely a face only a mother could
love.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A fire devil stands here with a box of matches, lighting up poor souls.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle fire devil

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
It is simply a large, door-sized wall of fire.  It slowly inches across the
room, burning everything in its path, including the poor souls that are chained
to the various posts around the room.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A wall of fire is here, creeping slowly across the room.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle wall fire

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This freak of a canine is rusty red to red-brown in color. Its eyes glow a
ghastly red. Its sooty black teeth and tongue are covered with green spittle
that runs down its dung covered coat.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A hell hound runs freely through the halls of hell.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle hell hound

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
As you look at the corpse, you recoil when you see that its eyes still
move.  They stare intently from its bluish face, as if pleading for your
help.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A frozen body lies on the ground.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle frozen body

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This devil is a mix of bug, bird, humanoid, and who knows what else.
Its multi-faceted eyes stare everywhere. It goes about its business of
slowly and painfully freezing the damned souls, quickly thawing them
and then starting over. Every couple of minutes, it takes time out to
break an appendage off a nearby soul and beat the soul with it.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A Greater Ice Devil stands here, cheerfully freezing souls.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle ice devil

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This poor soul has been incased in ice, almost as though it were caught
under an iceflow.  It will desperately gasp for air for a few minutes,
then will seem to die briefly.  Always, it is restored and begins thrashing
about again.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A soul trapped under the ice gasps desperately for air.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle trapped soul ice

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
A large meat hook is imbedded deep within the back of the corpse. You
see small white maggots eating away at the body. The flesh seems to
move and wriggle with a life of its own...
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A half frozen body hangs on a meat hook.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle half frozen body

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
What a cute little penguin! Wait, why is it looking at you that way?
HEY! Penguins don't have teeth!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small penguin waddles around on the ice.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle killer penguin

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
It moves about so frantically that you can't really get a chance to look at it.
It runs about screaming, 'I SCREAM, YOU SCREAM!

WE ALL SCREAM FOR I SCREAM!!!'
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An I-scream worker runs from machine to machine.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle i-scream worker

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He is dressed in a white jumpsuit with the words,

'Eye Spleen I Screamery'

written on it in large, yellow letters.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An Ice Screamer is yelling into empty cartons.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle ice screamer

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This huge demon has somehow managed to fit himself into
a oversized, orange jumpsuit. The words,

'4th DEMONsion Construction Co.' are written on the
back in large, black letters.
He seems none too happy to see you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A Demonic Foreman sits here, looking at blueprints.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle construction foreman demonic

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This very sexy secretary seems to be just sitting here amusing herself
by watching the little lights on the telephone blink. She is oblivious
to your presence and seems fascinated by the phones.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Secretary of Hell sits here, watching the phones ring.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle secretary of hell

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Just looking at him makes your blood boil.
AAAAAAAAAAaaaaaaaaaaaarrrrrrrrgggggghhhhh!!!!!!!!!!!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An office worker from Hell is looking for a boss to piss off.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle office worker hell

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see a rather plain-looking office personel here, filing paperwork on
someone.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A records worker is here, filing bad reports.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle records worker

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
It's a jolly old man, with red cheeks and a roly-poly belly and a laugh
as jolly as you can get. Must be Santa Claus!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Santa Claus is here, checking on who has been naughty...
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle santa claus

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The dark, black robes hide most of his features, but you can nearly make
out his emaciated face beneath the hood.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The High Priest of Hell is here, eating 'I Scream'.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle high priest ell

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: It is a wooden bowl filled with blood and bits of flesh.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A bowl of blood sits on the altar.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle bowl blood

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: It seems to be a lesser demon disguised as mortal. Fair trial?  Not likely.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A jury member sits here with a "Guilty" sign, waiting for the trial to begin.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle jury member

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This is the High Judge of Hell. He has never found anyone innocent
and is notorious for his painful and harsh punishments.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Judge Whopper sits here, trying to think of a painful sentence.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle judge whopper

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: Slimy, sleezy, and with very sharp teeth... A lawyer all right...
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Lawyer from Hell sits here, playing games on his laptop computer.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle lawyer hell

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
She seems not to notice you, but is absorbed in her favorite soap,
'As The Hell Burns'
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Complaints Officer is here, watching her favorite soap opera.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle complaints officer

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He looks at you and says, 'I think my Kung Fu is no good'
and then goes back to practicing.

He is known to buy anything, and to sell anything sold to him.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Bastard Hiramoto stands here, trying to learn Kung Fu from a book.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle bastard hiramoto

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He is in a yellow jumpsuit with a large nuclear-warning symbol on the back.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A maintenance worker is here, fixing stuff.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle maintenance worker

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You see a nasty yellow-and-purple weed.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A weed is growing out of the cement.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle weeds

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He is a crafty old fart who looks about 1000 years old, but his figurines
are pretty well-known.  He was rumored to have disappeared around Solace 100
years ago.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Stanley stands here, waiting to sell you one of his wonderful figurines.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle stanley

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This is what used to be a horse.  Hmm, maybe - it's hard to tell.  Half
of it has been digested already.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A half-eaten horse carcass is here being digested.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle half eaten horse carcass

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
A large, brown-and-green, slime-covered reptile, its function seems to be
to move to each food item and barf acid all over it.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A stomach dragon is here, digesting Big Mouth's food.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle stomach dragon

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
It's one of those really nasty pieces of food in the refrigerator that
disappears, and you wonder if it just walked away....
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A rancid turkey leg sits in a pool of slime.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle rancid turkey leg

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He is dressed in a black jumpsuit with a large nuclear-warning symbol on
the back.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A reactor specialist sits here, checking on the reactor core.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle reactor specialist

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He is dressed in a black jumpsuit with a large lighting bolt symbol on
the back.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A reactor worker sits here, monitoring various screens.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle reactor worker

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
A balding fat man with jelly stains on his uniform.

He suddenly spills his coffee and shouts out, 'DOH!'
Warning lights blink rapidly as the coffee shorts out the control panel.
Homer calmly stands up, unplugs the control panel, and sits down
for a nap.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Homer Simpson sits here, eating donuts.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle homer simpson

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: Mmmmmm...Don't you just want to take a bite?
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A nice slice of devil's food cake is here, waiting to be eaten.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle devil's food cake

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He spots you and screams, 'Git awa froom mi food!  I'll kill you!'
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A mad cook is here, cooking up a storm.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle mad cook

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A frantic lady is here, looking in vain for a sale and tearing her hair out.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle frantic lady

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A nuclear technician is here, fiddling with his rad suit.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle nuclear technician

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A stray proton is here, whizzing about.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle stray proton

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The radiation in the room does unknown things to you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle radiation

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He kinda reminds you of an old Bart Simpson.  He seems to be enjoying
the panic button at the moment, chuckling happily as workers on the
reactor floor below frantically check dials and gauges, while lights
are flashing and sirens are screaming in the background.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Chief Engineer of Hell is here, playing with the panic button.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle chief engineer hell

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This large, black-scaled demon laughs merrily as he watches poor souls
scream out in pain. He pokes and picks at the flesh of the damned who
were unlucky enough to be tortured close to him.  His black-taloned
nails rip slowly through their flesh as he cackles with glee at the
sounds of their unending pain...
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A Greater Fire Demon stands here, laughing at each scream he hears..
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle greater fire demon

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This enormous carcass looks as if it came from a small dragon or a very
large cow.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A frozen side of beef hangs on a hook.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle frozen side beef

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A vicious-looking pit bull / demon-dog mix is here, slobbering on the donuts.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A guard dog sits here, guarding the break room.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle guard dog

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: Mmmmmmm.....Steak....Mmmmmm...You feel your mouth start to water.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A mouth-watering, juicy steak is here, steaming.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle juicy steak
